# Desert Sound

> Desert Sound designs and installs premium home theater systems, smart home automation, audio systems, control integration, and home Wi-Fi networks in Karachi and across Pakistan.

Desert Sound is a Karachi-based home theatre, high-end audio-video, and smart home company. We specify products, handle the technical build, and deliver turn-key cinema rooms and smart homes across Pakistan, including Lahore and Islamabad. Work includes multi-room AV, home automation, motorized screens and curtains, custom theatre furniture, and installation of high-end equipment. The company is a CEDIA member.

Canonical site: https://www.desertsound.com.pk
